provenance.primary_source: Compiled from published first-principles (DFT) literature for wurtzite GaN and AlN; per-value citations in each entry. NOT computed in-house - this table is the phase-1 stand-in until backend='qe_local' can regenerate it.
provenance.honesty_note: Entries carry no two-point convergence records (per-paper settings are heterogeneous and mostly unpublished in extractable form), so every entry is flagged converged=false and adopted only under an explicit override_policy opt-in. Uncertainty bounds span the published calculation spread, which acts as a literature convergence proxy, not a substitute for one.

GaN.source: HSE/PBE plane-wave DFT, wurtzite GaN: PRB 99, 035201 (2019) Table I (PBE a=3.217 c=5.242 Eg=1.72; HSE a=3.178 c=5.168 Eg=3.45); elastic cluster from Wright-review theory and first-principles studies (C13 99-106, C33 372-405 GPa); e31/e33 Bernardini & Fiorentini first principles; p_sp Berry-phase DFT Bernardini 2001 (-0.029) with revised value -0.034 (Vurgaftman 2003 recommended; Dreyer 2016)
GaN.notes: HSE lattice constants adopted (PBE overestimates a by ~0.9%, c by ~1.1%). Band gap is HSE06@alpha=0.25; PBE raw gap recorded under dft_eg_uncorrected_eV and never adopted. p_sp spread covers original vs revised Berry-phase calculations.

AlN.source: HSE/PBE plane-wave DFT, wurtzite AlN: PRB 99, 035201 (2019) Table I (PBE a=3.126 c=5.010 Eg=4.07; HSE/PBEsol a=3.111 c=4.979); elastic first-principles cluster (C13 96-112, C33 355-402 GPa) with Wright-recommended 108/373; e31/e33 Bernardini & Fiorentini; p_sp Berry-phase DFT Bernardini 2001 (-0.081) with revised -0.090 (Vurgaftman 2003; rigorous calculations span -0.09 to -0.12)
AlN.notes: HSE lattice adopted. Band gap is HSE06@alpha=0.25, which underestimates wide-gap nitrides; G0W0 upper bound 6.35 eV included in the uncertainty. p_sp value is the Vurgaftman-recommended revised Berry-phase result.

p_sp_C_m2.source: Berry-phase DFT: Bernardini 2001 (-0.081); revised -0.090 (Vurgaftman 2003); rigorous span -0.09 to -0.12

Eg_eV.note: HSE06@alpha=0.25 underestimates wide-gap nitrides; G0W0 upper bound in hi
